name: Albert Hall Museum
description: Indo-Saracenic architecture museum built in 1887. Houses Egyptian mummy, Persian carpet, and Rajasthani artifacts.

name: Amber Fort
description: Massive hilltop Rajput fortress with Sheesh Mahal. UNESCO World Heritage site.

name: Birla Mandir (Laxmi Narayan Temple)
description: White marble temple built in 1988 by the Birla family. Combines modern and ancient temple architecture.

name: Chokhi Dhani
description: Rajasthani ethnic village resort. Traditional food, folk dances, puppet shows, camel rides, and cultural performances.

name: City Palace
description: Working royal palace with museums, courtyards, and famous oversized silver urns.

name: Galtaji (Monkey Temple)
description: Ancient pilgrimage site with natural springs in a mountain gorge. Famous for troops of monkeys. Featured in documentaries.

name: Hawa Mahal
description: Iconic pink sandstone Palace of Winds with 953 small windows. Built in 1799.

name: Jaigarh Fort
description: Fort of Victory on Cheel ka Teela with Jaivana cannon — world's largest wheeled cannon. Connected to Amber Fort.

name: Jal Mahal
description: Stunning palace in the middle of Man Sagar Lake. Five floors, four submerged. Beautifully lit at night.

name: Jantar Mantar
description: World's largest stone astronomical observatory. UNESCO World Heritage site.

name: Johari Bazaar
description: Jaipur's jewellery market since the 18th century. Gold, silver, precious stones.

name: Nahargarh Fort
description: Best sunset viewpoint in Jaipur. Overlooks the entire pink city.

name: Panna Meena Ka Kund
description: Beautiful 16th-century stepwell with symmetrical crisscross stairways. Instagram-famous geometric architecture.

name: Assam State Museum
description: Collection of tribal artifacts, sculptures, Ahom-era manuscripts, and textiles from Northeast India.

name: Brahmaputra River Sunset Cruise
description: Evening cruise on Asia's widest river. Sunset views with Assamese folk music and snacks aboard.

name: Kamakhya Temple
description: One of the most important Shakti Peethas on Nilachal Hill. Tantric temple with the annual Ambubachi Mela.

name: Srimanta Sankardev Kalakshetra
description: Cultural complex showcasing Assamese culture. Traditional huts, museum galleries, open-air theatre, and craft workshops.

name: Umananda Island Temple
description: Shiva temple on Peacock Island — smallest river island in the world. Ferry ride on the Brahmaputra.

name: Bijli Mahadev Temple
description: Temple at 7,874 ft where the Shiva lingam gets struck by lightning and shatters, then reassembled by priests.

name: GHNP Entry Gate Kullu
description: Gateway to the UNESCO Great Himalayan National Park from Kullu side. Trekking permits available here.

name: Kullu Shawl Market (Akhara Bazaar)
description: Famous for handwoven Kullu shawls and caps. Direct from local weavers at wholesale prices.

name: Raghunath Temple
description: Main deity temple of Kullu Valley. Center of the famous Kullu Dussehra festival celebrated for 7 days.

name: Bundi Palace (Garh Palace)
description: Rajput palace famous for Bundi-style miniature murals depicting court life, mythology, and nature.

name: Raniji Ki Baori
description: Multi-storied stepwell from 1699 with 46-meter depth. Intricately carved pillars and elephant sculptures.

name: Taragarh Fort
description: Star Fort built in 1354. Massive structure with huge reservoirs and views over the blue city of Bundi.

name: Kalpa Apple Orchards
description: Walk through terraced apple orchards with Kinner Kailash as backdrop. Best during Sept-Oct harvest.

name: Narayan-Nagini Temple
description: Ancient wooden temple with intricate carvings. Fine example of Kinnauri temple architecture.

name: Suicide Point (Roghi Village)
description: Dramatic cliff viewpoint overlooking Sutlej Gorge and Kinner Kailash range. Despite the name, a stunning photo spot.

name: Malana Village
description: Ancient village claiming descent from Alexander's army. Unique democracy and customs. Photography restricted.

name: Parvati-Beas Confluence (Bhuntar)
description: Where Parvati River meets the Beas. Scenic spot marking the entrance to Parvati Valley.

name: Tosh Village
description: Hilltop hamlet at 7,874 ft with traditional Himachali houses, apple orchards, and Parvati Valley views.

name: Om Parvat
description: A 6,191m peak near Nabhi whose north face naturally forms the sacred "Om" symbol in snow. Best viewed from Nabhidhang campsite at dawn.

name: Parvati Sarovar (Gauri Kund)
description: Glacial lake at the base of Adi Kailash, considered the bathing pool of goddess Parvati. The standard turnaround point for the yatra.

name: Kamadgiri Parikrama
description: 5 km circumambulation of the sacred Kamadgiri hill. Lined with temples and ashrams.

name: Ram Ghat
description: Most sacred ghat in Chitrakoot where Lord Rama performed aarti. Evening aarti ceremony on the Mandakini River.

name: BRO Cafeteria
description: The small cafeteria run by the army at the pass — hot tea, maggi, soup. Often cited as the 'highest cafeteria' in India at 5,359m. Oxygen first-aid available.

name: Khardung La pass summit
description: 5,359m (17,582ft) pass marker with prayer flags, a small stupa, and the BRO signage board — the definitive photo stop for every Ladakh road-trip. Built 1976 by the Border Roads Organisation; gateway to Nubra valley.

name: Ao Naga Village Trail
description: Walking trail through Ao Naga villages. Traditional morungs (dormitories), log drums, and warrior tradition.

name: Longkhum Village
description: Scenic hilltop village with views of Mt. Tiyi. Known as "Beholder of God" with old stone monoliths.

name: Ralang Monastery
description: Important Karma Kagyu monastery with elaborate murals and thangka paintings. Hosts annual Pang Lhabsol festival.

name: Tathagata Tsal (Buddha Park)
description: Serene park with a 130-ft statue of the Buddha surrounded by Himalayan peaks. Inaugurated by the Dalai Lama.

name: Ashoka Pillar & Relic Stupa
description: Well-preserved Ashoka Pillar with single lion capital. Relic stupa found to contain Buddha's ashes.

name: Vaishali Museum
description: Artifacts from ancient Vaishali — world's first republic. Terracotta, coins, and Buddhist sculptures.

name: Umngot River
description: Crystal-clear river where boats appear to float on air. Glass-bottom boat rides near India-Bangladesh border.

name: Kishtwar National Park
description: Rugged national park home to snow leopard, brown bear, and Himalayan ibex. Pristine and remote.

name: Phawngpui (Blue Mountain) Peak
description: Highest peak in Mizoram at 7,100 ft. Rhododendrons and orchids. Views stretching to Myanmar.

name: Zuluk Zigzag Road
description: Historic Silk Route with 32 hairpin bends visible from above. Kanchenjunga sunrise from Thambi viewpoint.
